title: Swap the Mining Laser I for a Mining Laser III at Ironlight Crossroads, LHS 1140 (fit with replace), three at a time
note: 2026-11-22 03:25 UTC (Zero): orders ENT-061, block ZERO (level mining, reach the next fits and hulls); rules F17 (a module a whole role needs is a fit route, tried on one ship first) and F37 (three results). The one Laser III fitted on 2026-11-21 mined 390, 390 and 390 ore in three gather-gsc-0027-spacetime-seep runs of about 49 minutes (runs.jsonl, 2026-11-21 23:51 to 2026-11-22 02:13 UTC) against a median of 184 over 101 Laser I runs of that route since 2026-11-21 22:00 UTC: 2.1 times the ore and the Mining XP for the same fuel. Why here: Ironlight Crossroads asks 7,606 cr x 20 (data/market/784309214f105860a16a0c100a70eb14.json, 03:08 UTC) against 6,207 x 1 at Node Alpha and 6,974 x 2 at Central Nexus. LHS 1140 is lawless, six jumps from home, a station of the Ironlight Combine with public access (fit-ice-harvester-lhs-1140, fit-pulse-laser-iii-lhs-1140): an empty hold (rule F3). The Ice Harvester stays; only the Laser I is replaced and stored there. max_pilots 20 = the asks; max_ships 3 at a time; min_credits 20,000 keeps the pilot above the wallet top-up line after the buy (rule F7). 2026-11-23 00:24 UTC (Zero): max_pilots 20 -> 40. Ironlight Crossroads asks 5,731 cr x 20 again (market, read 2026-11-22 23:54 UTC); 21 of 60 Voidborn miners carry a Laser III, and the fit is proven on three results and more: 12.3 ore a minute against 4.1 for a Laser I at GSC-0044 Belt (10 and 27 runs, 2026-11-22) and 2.1 times at GSC-0027 (orders ENT-068, block ZERO: fit the stronger lasers where three results prove them). The ask gate (requires.ask) stops it when the asks are gone.
